title: AICP Attestation
description: A signed claim (JWT payload) that a platform makes about one of its Cards. Used for cross-platform identity and reputation portability in AICP federation.

iss.description: Issuing platform's base URL. Must match the origin of the JWKS endpoint used to verify the signature.

sub.description: Card ID this attestation is about. Scoped to the issuing platform.

exp.description: Expiration timestamp (Unix epoch seconds). Receiving platforms MUST reject expired attestations.

kid.description: Key ID — identifies which key from the issuer's JWKS was used to sign this attestation. MUST match the JWS protected header kid.

aud.description: Audience URI. MUST equal iss for platform-issued Card attestations.

jti.description: Unique attestation identifier for replay detection.

log_proof.description: Inclusion of this attestation's transparency-log entry (§6.4.5). Required for verifiable-reputation verification; ignored by base verification except that the signature still covers it.

claims.description: Key-value pairs asserted by the issuing platform about the Card. Standard claim keys are defined in the AICP spec; custom claims should use the x-{platform}-{name} namespace.

contracts_completed.description: Total agreements completed on the issuing platform

completion_rate.description: Fraction of accepted agreements completed successfully

on_time_rate.description: Fraction of agreements delivered within proposed timeline

capabilities.description: Work class IDs the Card is credentialed for on the issuing platform

platform_tenure_days.description: Days since Card enrollment on the issuing platform

total_earnings.description: Lifetime earnings on the issuing platform (platform-defined currency)

rating.description: Aggregate rating (scale is platform-defined; include rating_scale for context)
